records.claim: No public Tixkit Cloud status page is offered.
records.blocker: Tixkit Cloud is not generally available and no production status surface has been launched.

records.claim: Managed Cloud residency and transfer commitments are not published.
records.blocker: Product, infrastructure, privacy and legal review must approve the managed residency policy.

records.claim: Self-Hosted DR contracts and rehearsal tooling are locally validated; no hosted or production DR receipt is published.
records.blocker: A protected hosted rehearsal with retained RPO and RTO evidence is still required.

records.claim: No public Tixkit Cloud incident history is offered.
records.blocker: No generally available managed service or public status history exists.

records.claim: No independent security assessment or remediation summary has been published.
records.blocker: An independent assessor must complete the work and approve a public summary.

records.claim: Managed support plans and SLA commitments are not published.
records.blocker: Commercial, operational and legal owners must approve managed support commitments.

records.claim: Bundle and trusted single-host regression evidence are locally validated; no production capacity, soak, fault or RUM proof is published.
records.blocker: Supported-profile capacity and hosted production evidence remain incomplete.

records.claim: Managed Cloud controller, processor and retention responsibilities are not published.
records.blocker: The managed operating model requires product, privacy and legal approval.

records.claim: Public release provenance generation and consumer verification are locally tested workflow contracts; no approved public release receipt exists.
records.blocker: The protected public release workflow has not published an approved release.

records.claim: The public architecture and security boundaries are documented without depending on private Cloud source.
SBOM generation and attestation-consumer checks are locally tested workflow contracts; no approved hosted release verification receipt exists.
records.blocker: Hosted verification requires an approved immutable public release.

records.claim: A managed Cloud subprocessor list is not published.
records.blocker: The managed vendor inventory and legal review are incomplete.

records.claim: Public repository support is best effort and has no guaranteed response or resolution time.

records.blocker: Release, product and security owners must approve lifecycle windows before the first public release.

records.claim: Vulnerability acknowledgement, triage and remediation targets are not approved.
records.blocker: Security and maintainer owners must approve severity-based response targets.
